ai.summary: A military-linked Chinese university bought two Nvidia H200 chips despite being on a U.S. export blacklist, according to procurement records reviewed by Reuters. The purchase highlights potential gaps in controls on advanced AI hardware reaching restricted institutions.
ai.title: Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show

ai.summary: Chinese AI companies are seeking to reserve Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centers outside China, amid concern Washington may curb remote access to advanced chips. The reported scramble underscores how cloud access has become a flashpoint in U.S.-China AI technology controls.
ai.title: Chinese AI firms rush to secure Nvidia chip capacity as spy scandal stirs fear of US curbs

ai.summary: A Capgemini survey found that 59% of senior executives at large companies plan to increase their use of open-weight AI models over the next year, citing higher-than-expected AI costs. Respondents still expect to use closed models for tasks where they consider the added capability worth the price.
ai.title: Most large firms plan higher open-weight AI use to cap bills, study shows

ai.summary: Goldman Sachs forecast that U.S. spending on AI-related hardware and intellectual property will exceed $900 billion by the end of 2026 and reach an annualized $1.4 trillion by the end of 2027. The bank expects AI to remain the leading driver of business investment growth next year.
ai.title: AI to stay dominant force behind US business investment in 2027, Goldman says

ai.summary: Anthropic is preparing an IPO that could value the AI company at up to $1.4 trillion, with a planned share sale of as much as $64.4 billion, Reuters reported. A separate $26 billion private placement involving major technology investors would make the offering a significant test of investor appetite for AI companies amid questions about spending and returns.
ai.title: How Anthropic stacks up against some of the biggest US IPOs

quantum.summary: IBM announced its planned Nighthawk r3 processor, designed to execute 10,000 quantum operations across 520 qubits. The company also said it plans to connect two processors into a 1,040-qubit system in 2027; these are roadmap targets, not reported results from an available system.
quantum.title: IBM Announces Nighthawk r3, Plans 1040-Qubit System for 2027

quantum.summary: PsiQuantum and AMD expanded their partnership to develop computing infrastructure combining photonic quantum hardware with AMD CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs and software. They also described work on implementing PsiQuantum’s machine-learning decoder for low-latency error correction on programmable accelerators.
quantum.title: PsiQuantum and AMD Collaborate to Build the Computing Foundation for Utility-Scale Quantum Computing

quantum.summary: Purdue researchers reported a machine-learning approach that predicts spectral shifts linked to decoherence in quantum emitters; in the studied systems, using those predictions reduced the shifts by as much as 20-fold. The university notes that the underlying research was published in Nature Communications earlier this year, so this is a new institutional report about prior work.
quantum.title: Research advances quantum computing that harnesses speed of light

quantum.summary: A cross-platform study tested GHZ-state entanglement through cloud-accessible quantum processors from several providers. Its report says the largest state passing the test involved 27 qubits on IBM hardware, while only four of nine processors certified genuine multipartite entanglement under the study’s strictest rule.
quantum.title: The best of nine cloud quantum computers entangled 27 of its 120 qubits, and four of the nine could certify any entanglement at all

quantum.summary: QuiX Quantum and partner organizations received funding for a national program to develop the technology stack for a universal photonic quantum computer with more than 100 qubits. The multi-year effort covers components including photon sources, chips, detectors, control electronics and manufacturing.
quantum.title: QuiX Quantum and Seven Partners Awarded National Mission To Build the Technology Foundations for a 100+ Qubit Photonic Quantum Computer

quantum.summary: Xanadu reported third-quarter revenue growth and described partnerships and government support tied to its photonic-computing roadmap. The article also notes the company’s targets of up to 200 logical qubits by 2029 and more than 1,000 by 2031—future goals, not current capabilities.
quantum.title: Xanadu Reports Revenue Growth as Photonic Partnerships and Government Support Expand
